import pandas as pd
CSVQA_FRAMES = {t["table_id"]: pd.DataFrame([r["values"] for r in t["records"]], columns=t["columns"], index=[r["source_row"] for r in t["records"]]) for t in CSVQA_DATA["tables"]}
import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB

def solve_problem():
    plants = []
    plant_supply = {}
    frame_plants = CSVQA_FRAMES['file_1_view_0']
    for (_, row) in frame_plants.iterrows():
        plant = row['Unnamed: 0']
        plants.append(plant)
        plant_supply[plant] = float(row['supply_capacity'])
    outlets = []
    outlet_demand = {}
    frame_outlets = CSVQA_FRAMES['file_0_view_0']
    for (_, row) in frame_outlets.iterrows():
        outlet = row['customer']
        outlets.append(outlet)
        outlet_demand[outlet] = float(row['demand'])
    cost = {}
    frame_cost = CSVQA_FRAMES['file_2_view_0']
    for (_, row) in frame_cost.iterrows():
        i = row['Unnamed: 0']
        cost[i] = {}
        for j in outlets:
            cost[i][j] = float(row[j])
    if set(plants) != set(cost.keys()):
        raise ValueError('Mismatch between plants and cost matrix rows')
    for i in plants:
        if set(outlets) != set(cost[i].keys()):
            raise ValueError(f'Mismatch between outlets and cost matrix columns for plant {i}')
    if set(plants) != set(plant_supply.keys()):
        raise ValueError('Mismatch between plants and supply capacity')
    if set(outlets) != set(outlet_demand.keys()):
        raise ValueError('Mismatch between outlets and demand')
    m = gp.Model('BrewCo_Transportation')
    m.setParam('MIPGap', 0.0001)
    quantity_vars = m.addVars(plants, outlets, lb=0, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='')
    m.setObjective(gp.quicksum((cost[i][j] * quantity_vars[i, j] for i in plants for j in outlets)), GRB.MINIMIZE)
    m.addConstrs((gp.quicksum((quantity_vars[i, j] for i in plants)) >= outlet_demand[j] for j in outlets), name='')
    m.addConstrs((gp.quicksum((quantity_vars[i, j] for j in outlets)) <= plant_supply[i] for i in plants), name='')
    m.optimize()
    if m.Status == GRB.OPTIMAL:
        print(f'ObjVal: {m.ObjVal}')
        for var in m.getVars():
            print(f'{var.VarName}: {var.X}')
    else:
        print(f'Solver status: {m.Status}')
    return m
m = solve_problem()
